How much does Allo cost, and what's included?

Allo offers three per-user plans, billed monthly or yearly. Starter is $18/user/month for one user (billed annually). Business is $32/user/month billed yearly (or $45 monthly). Ultra is $100/user/month billed yearly (or $120 monthly). Every paid plan includes AI call transcription, AI summaries, the AI Receptionist and native CRM sync (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio and more) at no extra cost, plus a business phone number, free porting of existing numbers and unlimited national calls. Allo has no setup fees and no contracts, includes a 7-day free trial, and its Business plan is priced about 10% below Aircall.
Per user, per month, billed monthly or yearly. Starter is a single user billed annually. Business and Ultra scale with your team. You only pay for the seats you use, with no setup fees.
Is AI included, or is it a paid add-on?
Included. Every paid plan comes with AI transcription, summaries and CRM sync at no extra cost. The agentic features simply unlock as you move from Starter to Business to Ultra.
Both, for Business and Ultra: yearly billing costs less per month. Starter is billed yearly only. You can switch billing or plan whenever you want.
Are there setup fees or contracts?
No setup fees and no contracts. You pay only for what you use and can upgrade, downgrade or cancel anytime, with no lock-in.
What happens when I add or remove users?
You're billed per seat. Add or remove team members whenever you need, and changes are prorated, so you never pay for seats you don't use.
Do I have to talk to sales to start?
No. Starter and Business start in minutes straight from the app. Ultra and larger migrations get a dedicated onboarding when you contact sales.
Is keeping my current number an extra cost?
No. We port your existing numbers for free, usually live within minutes. New numbers can be generated instantly in 80+ countries.
